# CLAUDE.md patch — append after existing content

> Append the following section to your existing `CLAUDE.md`. If your project does not have one yet,
> create `CLAUDE.md` at repo root with this content plus your own project context above.

```markdown
@AGENTS.md

# QA standard (generated by qa-architect, {{ISO_DATE}})

## Test conventions

- Preferuj testy zachowania użytkownika, nie detali implementacyjnych.
- `data-testid` stosuj wyłącznie jako escape hatch — domyślnie `getByRole({ name })`, potem `getByLabelText`, `getByText`.
- Dla route handlers / API endpoints **najpierw pisz test integracyjny**, potem implementację.
- Dla zapytań SQL używaj **prawdziwego PostgreSQL w Testcontainers** — `jest.mock('pg')` i analogi są zabronione.
- Dla zmian UI uruchom przed PR: `{{TEST_RUN_CMD}} && {{TEST_E2E_CMD}}`.
- Przy niepowodzeniu CI: zapisz raport, trace lub screenshot jako artefakt (workflow już ma `if: always()`).

## When to use which skill

| Use case | Skill |
|---|---|
| Implement a new feature with TDD | `audited-feature-workflow` (`/goal` for autonomous mode) |
| Run full e2e + a11y + visual diff | `playwright-test-suite` |
| Setup or audit QA blueprint | `qa-architect` (you are reading its output) |
| Long-running multi-agent work (>2h) | `swarm-orchestrator` |

## Verify command

To verify any change touches the right test layers, ask Claude Code:
```
/verify-tests
```
This invokes `.claude/skills/verify-tests/SKILL.md` (see `verify-tests/SKILL.md`).

## Postgres test policy (non-negotiable)

Testowanie warstwy SQL **wyłącznie** na realnym PostgreSQL (Testcontainers per-suite lub Docker Compose).
Mock-Postgres libraries (`pg-mem`, `sqlmock` bez testcontainers w tym samym pliku, in-memory substytut) — zabronione.
Powód: semantyka transakcji + izolacji + parameterized queries `pg`/`psycopg`/`pgx` ≠ mock.
Patrz: `qa-blueprint/03-layer-strategy.md` §3.
```

---

## How to merge

1. Read the section above.
2. If your `CLAUDE.md` does not have an `## QA standard` section — append as-is.
3. If it does — review carefully, merge field by field, do NOT blindly overwrite team-specific content.
4. Replace placeholders `{{TEST_RUN_CMD}}` and `{{TEST_E2E_CMD}}` with stack-specific commands from `configs/package.json-scripts.json` (or pyproject/go equivalent).

> Note: `qa-architect` does NOT auto-merge this patch. APPROVAL #2 from the user is required.
